title: Majority of Roman theologians: all three Suarez modes are right and pious
source_text: IX. Denique maxima pars Theologorum Ecclesiae Romanae censet imagines tribus hisce modis recte & pie adorari posse: Nimirum adorationem proprie & per se dirigendo, vel ad solum exemplar, vel ad solam imaginem, vel ad exemplar & imaginem simul, tanquam unum objectum totale.
pass_a_gloss: Finally the greatest part of the Theologians of the Roman Church judges that images can rightly and piously be adored in these three modes: namely by directing adoration properly and per se, either to the exemplar alone, or to the image alone, or to exemplar and image together, as one total object.
pass_b_english: The Roman majority blesses all three Suarez modes as right and pious.
Adoration may terminate on exemplar alone, image alone, or both as one total object.
